response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(p.product_color), '') AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(p.product_color), '')), grand AS (SELECT SUM(invoiced) AS total FROM color_totals), avg_per_color AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_amt FROM color_totals), shares AS (SELECT c.color, c.invoiced, c.invoiced * 1.0 / g.total AS share, a.avg_amt FROM color_totals c CROSS JOIN grand g CROSS JOIN avg_per_color a) SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(invoiced - avg_amt) AS avg_amount_above_per_color_average FROM shares WHERE invoiced > avg_amt;
